hooks.description: Hard-block destructive Bash; auto-approve the plugin's curated read-only commands
Auto-approve read-only MCP fetches (testrail/github reads, Atlassian Jira reads); write tools like createJiraIssue still prompt
Auto-approve writes to the plugin's own generated files (.buddy-council config/progress, secrets, plugin .mcp.json); all other writes still prompt
Append a redacted one-line record of every tool call to .buddy-council/logs/ (only in projects that use the plugin)
